title: Pubnet ledger 36118628: real PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_OFFER_CROSS_SELF
why: A ledger the network actually closed that holds this arm: PathPaymentStrictSendResult::PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_OFFER_CROSS_SELF. Generated entries had none of them, so a reader's handling of them was never exercised on bytes stellar-core wrote under real traffic.

notes: Found by xdrcheck-corpus mine (the smallest ledger of the sampled range that shows the arm). Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture; expect is the reference extractor's output.
